entries.zh: 缴纳贡赋（tributos）；纳粮以完赋税
entries.en: to pay tribute/taxes; to pay the tribute in grain
entries.notes: R 栏空；M『lap búy』次音未能确定（疑即納米），后半段 chīn chŷ nīō 与第 11 条『稱錢糧』同形。

entries.zh: 以现银缴纳（教会）圣俸；将应缴之数折为银钱交纳
entries.en: to pay a benefice (stipend) in cash; to commute a due into money
entries.notes: L『Benef.o』当为 beneficio；H 作『酥』与义不合，疑『租』之刻讹（M chó 正合『租』），末字『lè』未能定。

entries.zh: 付店钱；结付住店房钱
entries.en: to pay for lodging; to pay the room/inn charge

entries.zh: 付还住店钱；清付房钱
entries.en: to pay back the lodging charge; to settle the room rent

entries.zh: 如数偿还；按理结清应付之数
entries.en: to pay what is just/due; to settle fairly

entries.zh: 赔还；双份赔付（代他人偿付）
entries.en: to repay/compensate; to pay for two, i.e. on another's behalf

entries.zh: 代赔；替人赔偿
entries.en: to compensate in another's place; to pay for someone else

entries.zh: 克己赔付；自掏腰包代偿（所担保之债）
entries.en: to make good out of one's own pocket; to pay a debt one stands surety for
entries.notes: H『巳』当为『己』，全词还原作『克己賠』（khek-kí-puê）；L『fio』即 fío（信用、担保）。

entries.zh: 沿途逐处付清（一站接一站）
entries.en: to pay at each place along the road, one after another
entries.notes: L『otros por otros』谓依次相代；H『經過』只取行程义，非逐字对译。

entries.zh: 按期准时付清；如时清缴
entries.en: to pay punctually; to settle promptly
entries.notes: H 第二字标〔疑〕，M chīet 或为『切』，全词未能确定；释义主要依 L。

entries.zh: 缴纳钱粮（秤量银谷完纳赋税）
entries.en: to pay the tribute in money and grain (weighed out)

entries.zh: 付足全额；缴足应纳之数
entries.en: to pay the full amount; to make up the whole sum
entries.notes: L『los deme』文义残缺（疑 los demás）；H『足額』与 M tsiok-giek 密合。

entries.zh: 如数付足；按数缴清
entries.en: to pay the full count/sum; to pay in full
entries.notes: 同第 12 条，L 残；H『足數』与 M tsiok-siàu 密合。

entries.zh: 缴销牌照、纳牌费（原文并及十二两银之数，语意未详）
entries.en: to surrender/cancel a licence tablet and pay the fee (the Spanish adds twelve taels at an unclear rate)
entries.notes: H『碑』疑为『牌』（同音 pâi），当作『銷牌』；L『.12. taes por el mas a caso』残缺难解。

entries.zh: 缴纳牌照税（patente，华人营业牌照银）；交付新收之银
entries.en: to pay the licence (patente) fee; to hand over the silver newly taken in
entries.notes: L『pres』疑为 precio/presente 之省；H『新收銀』指新收得之银。

entries.zh: 自作自受，自身之罪自身担当（不累他人）
entries.en: to answer for one's own sin oneself; each bears the burden of his own deed
entries.notes: H『佐』『舵』为借音字，还原作『身做身擔當』（sīn-chò-sīn-tam-tong）。

entries.zh: 赎罪；为罪罚作补赎
entries.en: to redeem sin; to pay/atone for one's condemnation

entries.zh: 付聘银；纳聘礼之银
entries.en: to pay the betrothal silver
entries.notes: L『q̃to』缩写未能确定（或为 quinto），与 H『聘銀』不合，释义从 H、M。

entries.zh: 下定行聘；议定聘礼
entries.en: to settle the betrothal; to fix the bride-price
entries.notes: 同上条，『q̃to』未定；M 第二段『tē siā̃』未详。

entries.zh: 发饷与兵（以粮充饷）
entries.en: to pay the soldiers (in grain/rations)
entries.notes: H『糶』与 M niō（糧）不合，疑『出糧』；M 第二段『lōā pōng niō̃』未详。

entries.zh: 依契约（交关）结账付款
entries.en: to pay by contract; to settle a trade account
entries.notes: L『contrado』当为 contrato；H『吊水交關』中『吊水』未详，释义仅取『交關』交易义。

entries.zh: 追偿欠债、交还债主；强制清还
entries.en: to recover a debt and pay it to its owner; to enforce payment of a debt
entries.notes: M『gûip』与『給』常音 kip 不合，字形仍从 H。
